caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with highly detailed geometric paneling and spindle decorations, composed primarily of shades of brown with reddish accents and dark outlines enhancing the structure’s depth and dimension. The cabinet has two large square doors in the upper section, each door featuring a central recessed panel with layered moldings in reddish-brown and tan tones. Below these doors are three horizontal rows, each containing two drawers with faceted, angular fronts that incorporate rectangular and triangular designs as well as small circular drawer pulls. Additional vertical and diagonal spindle-like elements accentuate the lower two rows of drawers, and the piece stands on four short, angular legs. Above the cabinet, in the upper left quadrant of the drawing, there is a separate, smaller object shaped like a wooden knob or furniture pull, rendered in a matching brown wood tone with shading to give it a three-dimensional appearance. The background is plain and off-white. The artist’s signature “MICHAEL TREKOR” appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Chest (with two drawers)
